name: Gorespur Cleric
body:
GORESPUR CLERIC 7
CR 7

XP 3,200
Male gorespur cleric 7
CE Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+5 armor, +1 dodge, +2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 80 (2d10+7d8+34)
Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +13
Defensive Abilities ferocity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +14 (1d6+6), 2 claws +14 (1d6+6)
Special Attacks channel negative energy 1/day (DC 10, 4d6), rend (2 claws, 1d6+8), retractable arm-blades
Domain Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +11)

7/day-battle rage (+3), consume the enemy (+2, 3 minutes)

Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +11)

4th–aura of doom (DC 19), blessing of fervor, divine powerD
3rd–bestow curse (DC 18), blood scent, cure serious wounds, magic vestmentD
2nd–aid, boneshaker (DC 17), bull’s strength, enemy’s heartD, ironskin
1st–bane (DC 15), cure light wounds (2), doom (DC 16), magic fangD, shield of faith
0 (at will)–bleed (DC 15), detect magic, guidance, stabilize

D domain spell; Domains Cannibalism (Evil subdomain), War

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 15, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 18, Cha 4
Base Atk +7; CMB +12; CMD 25
Feats Dodge, Intimidating Prowess, Spell Focus (necromancy), Weapon Focus (bite, claw)
Skills Intimidate +8, Knowledge (religion) +4, Perception +9, Sense Motive +9, Stealth +7, Survival +9
Languages Gorespur
Gear masterwork horn lamellar armor, amulet of mighty fists +1, cloak of resistance +1, pearl of power (1st), bone unholy symbol, spell component pouch

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Retractable Arm-blades (Ex)

A gorespur can extend or retract its arm-blades as a swift action. A gorespur with extended arm-blades cannot use its hands to hold items, but gains two primary claw attacks. An arm-blade can be sundered or disarmed, and it is treated as a scizore for that purpose. A disarmed or sundered arm-blade is destroyed and regrows in 24 hours.
